mode.description: WebSocket gateway (default). webhook/middleware use httpHostToken POST.

botKind.description: 公域/私域：均含 GROUP_AND_C2C_EVENT；频道消息分别为 PUBLIC_GUILD_MESSAGES / GUILD_MESSAGES。未显式配置 intents 时按此展开

en.description: Public/private bot type. Both include GROUP_AND_C2C_EVENT; channel messages use PUBLIC_GUILD_MESSAGES or GUILD_MESSAGES respectively. Used to derive intents when they are not explicitly configured.

master.description: 框架 master（endpoint 管理命令、AI/工具权限）；openid。endpoints[i].master 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Framework masters (openid) for endpoint management and AI/tool permissions. endpoints[i].master can override this value.

trusted.description: 框架 trusted 用户列表（弱于 master）。endpoints[i].trusted 可逐项追加

en.description: Framework trusted users, below master authority. endpoints[i].trusted can add users.

intents.description: WebSocket Identify intents；省略时按 botKind 自动生成（public→含 PUBLIC_GUILD_MESSAGES）

en.description: WebSocket Identify intents. When omitted, derived from botKind; public includes PUBLIC_GUILD_MESSAGES.

webhookPath.description: POST path on httpHostToken for webhook/middleware modes.

endpoints.description: 多账号：每项定义一个 endpoint，id/appid/secret 必填，其余字段覆盖实例默认值

master.description: 本 endpoint 的框架 master（openid）；覆盖顶层 master

en.description: Framework masters for this endpoint (openid), overriding the top-level master list.

trusted.description: 本 endpoint 的 trusted 列表

botKind.description: 覆盖顶层 botKind（公域/私域），用于按 endpoint 生成 intents

en.description: Override top-level botKind (public/private) when deriving this endpoint's intents.

streamProxy.description: Optional fixed loopback TCP fault proxy for WSS only; original gateway TLS identity must match serverName.

en.description: Multiple accounts: each entry defines an endpoint. id, appid and secret are required; other fields override instance defaults.

commandPrefix.description: 命令前缀（默认 '' 无前缀，任意文本按命令匹配；如 '/' 要求 / 开头）。endpoints[i] 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Command prefix. The default empty string allows unprefixed commands; '/' requires a leading slash. Each endpoints[i] can override it.

streamProxy.description: Optional fixed loopback TCP fault proxy for WSS only; original gateway TLS identity must match serverName.
